mapper.insert: insert into student_point_record (user_id, stage, biz_type, biz_id, points, balance_after, reason, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{stage}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{points}, #{balanceAfter}, #{reason}, now()) on duplicate key update record_id = record_id
mapper.select: select count(1) from student_point_record r where r.user_id = #{userId} and r.biz_type = #{bizType} and r.biz_id = #{bizId}

select coalesce(sum(r.points), 0) from student_point_record r where r.user_id = #{userId} and r.points > 0
and r.biz_type in #{item}
